snippet.title: Indie Game - Barely Breathing Trailer
snippet.description:
Try Demo and Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4514070/Barely_Breathing/

Barely Breathing is a 3D Physics-based Puzzle/Platformer where you play as Sheen, a goldfish who is bored of her dull life and wants to get out of the house to explore the world. You have to explore the house looking for water sources in the house to try to escape it. If you can't you have to flop your way through!

Join our discord!: https://discord.gg/K2zEs6WmFF

Music by: Anastasia Chubarova
